title: Frontend: Milestones tab — list, create, complete, delete, reorder with drag-and-drop
description: Build the Milestones tab with a sortable list of milestones, inline creation form, status updates, and drag-to-reorder.
acceptanceCriteria: Lists all milestones sorted by sort_order
Each milestone shows: name, status badge, due date (if set), completion checkbox
Inline 'Add milestone' form at bottom of list

steps.details: Create src/components/project/tabs/MilestonesTab.tsx. Use @dnd-kit/sortable to wrap milestone items. On drag end, call reorder API with new order. Optimistic update: re-order in local state immediately, revert on API error.

Create src/components/project/MilestoneItem.tsx. Drag handle (grip icon), name, status badge (colored), due date, complete checkbox. Complete checkbox: calls POST /complete endpoint. On completion: show confetti (TASK-96). Delete: shadcn/ui AlertDialog for confirmation.
Below milestone list: Input for milestone name + optional due date picker + 'Add' button. On submit: POST /api/projects/:id/milestones, invalidate milestones query.
Create 3 milestones. Drag to reorder — verify persists after reload. Complete a milestone — verify confetti animation and status change. Delete one — verify removed.
